BD Tourist Guide Documentation
===============================

BD Tourist Guide is a Django web application that connects travelers with
verified local guides in Bangladesh. Visitors can browse destinations and
search public guide profiles. Registered travelers can request guides, while
approved guides manage availability, respond to requests, and review trip
feedback.

This documentation covers local setup, the Django MTV architecture, the main
user workflows and data model, and selected Python APIs generated from source
docstrings.
